name: Validate campaign content
description: Call this when you need to check whether a specific email campaign's content passes Brevo's pre-send validation checks, and you want the list of blocking problems before committing to a send. Use it as the gate ahead of campaigns.send_now, so a send is only attempted once hasError is false. To read the campaign's own definition (subject, sender, recipients, status) rather than its validation state, use campaigns.get_campaign instead; to deliver the campaign once validation is clean, use campaigns.send_now.
preconditions: The campaign must already exist and be identified by its numeric campaign id.
The caller must be authenticated to the Brevo web app account that owns the campaign.

id.description: Numeric id of the campaign whose content should be validated, taken from the campaign's URL or from a campaign listing action. Observed value: 3.

hasError.description: True when at least one validation problem was found, false when the campaign content passed every check performed.

errors.description: The validation problems found. Observed empty on a campaign that passed; the shape of individual entries was not observed.

items.description: A single validation problem reported for the campaign content. Structure not observed in the available evidence.
